text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-It's finally here... The inter-class long-distance relay match!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It seems the Chairwoman has come to watch as well. As our class representative, please do your best, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass, King, Sei-chan, and Tsuru-chan too! Of course, El is cheering with all her heart and full power desu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you! Being the anchor is a huge responsibility, but... I'll ganbaru with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There is no need to be so nervous. You relay runners have the class cheer squad, led by King herself, behind you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'll be cheering from the stands too! With your late-charge kick, Spe-chan, you'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan will also be cheering for you in her dreams while taking a nap—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! We cheer together as a class desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so the inter-class relay began. While Special Week's class held the lead in the early stages—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other classes showed their determination, gradually closing the gap. By the time the anchor leg approached, it had turned into a fierce, neck-and-neck contest where neither side yielded an inch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu... It's almost time for me to go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I have to win somehow, somehow... As the anchor, I have to...! Otherwise, everyone's hard work will be wasted—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hold on, you silly girl. Did you think King would ever permit the outrage of piling all the responsibility onto one single person?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah~. Relax your shoulders a bit. You'll probably pull off a nice win if you're loose and relaxed, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your strength is something we, your rivals, can vouch for. Please run with your head held high and proud, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Yo también! El guarantees you're the strongest desu!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Everyone, let's send some cheers to our anchor! ...Ready, set!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Spe-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (My body feels so light—everyone's voices are pushing me forward, propelling me ahead...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (I'm not alone. Carrying everyone's hopes—I'm running together with everyone!)

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Gooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Until now, and forever onward, I want to keep running together with everyone!!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid! A truly magnificent contest! Special Week's run in particular surely provided wonderful inspiration to all around her!
choice_data_list: That was a truly wonderful run.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! By the way, Trainer <username>! What do you believe is the source of her strength?
choice_data_list: The presence of her rivals, perhaps?
Her straightforward, unyielding spirit, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Agreement! Competing against one another and elevating each other serves as immense power for a horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Both she and the other horse girls will surely meet many more rivals going forward.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And on the path toward their dreams, gaining a wealth of experience, they will grow ever stronger.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I feel as though I caught a glimpse of that golden future in today's race! Splendid, simply splendid!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to what's ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We must continue dedicating ourselves so the horse girls can run just like she does—I made that silent vow alongside Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Agreement! Maintaining an unyielding heart sounds simple, yet is exceedingly difficult!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Racing is a world of battling against rivals, and ultimately against oneself.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Living constantly amidst competition, I have seen many students lose heart and walk away.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In such an environment, her ability to stay true to her convictions without wavering makes her strong. From here on, she will surely continue running straight ahead as far as she can go.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to what's ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We must continue dedicating ourselves so the horse girls can run just like she does—I made that silent vow alongside Chairwoman Akikawa.
